'''Ileris Tik'kla''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]] who acted as an [[Ambassador]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] early in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Along with her aid [[Niak]], she was assigned to negotiate with ambasssador [[Woz Kaza]] for weapons for the Alliance. Tik'kla was able to get Kaza's family diverted away from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ileris Tik'kla appears in the opening story in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2015]] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook ''[[Desperate Allies]]''.
